schema.label: Schema only
schema.detail: Table and column names, types and relationships. No values from your database. Answers about the data itself will be generic.

screen.label: Schema and what is on screen
screen.detail: Also a few rows of the result you are looking at, and the cell or row you selected. The AI cannot run queries of its own.

queries.label: Schema, screen and read-only queries
queries.detail: Also lets the AI run read-only queries and read their rows, with your approval for each one. The most accurate answers.
